atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(60, "Coil Lookback", 10, 120, 1)
rangeLen = input(60, "Range Lookback", 10, 120, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VolOfVol Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
compThresh = input(0.25, "Compression Threshold", 0.05, 0.5, 0.05)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
expMult = input(1.5, "Expansion Mult", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

prevC = close[1]
trUp = abs(high - prevC)
trDn = abs(low - prevC)
rngHL = high - low
trFull = max(rngHL, max(trUp, trDn))
tr = bar_index == 0 ? rngHL : trFull

atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rangeNow = high - low

coilMax = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
coilMin = lowest(atrVal, coilLen)
coilSpan = max(coilMax - coilMin, 0.000000001)
coilLoad = 1 - (atrVal - coilMin) / coilSpan

rngMax = highest(rangeNow, rangeLen)
rngMin = lowest(rangeNow, rangeLen)
rngSpan = max(rngMax - rngMin, 0.000000001)
rangeCoil = 1 - (rangeNow - rngMin) / rngSpan

finalLoadRaw = (coilLoad + rangeCoil) / 2
finalLoad = max(0.0, min(1.0, finalLoadRaw))

atrChg = atrVal - atrVal[1]
vovRaw = stdev(atrChg, vovLen) / max(atrVal, 0.000000001)
volOfVol = max(vovRaw, 0.0)
risingVoV = volOfVol > volOfVol[1]

chg1 = bar_index == 0 ? 0.0 : close - close[1]
absChg = abs(chg1)
avgAbs = sma(absChg, predLen)
avgTR = sma(tr, predLen)
effRatio = avgAbs / max(avgTR, 0.000000001)
predRaw = effRatio
predictability = max(0.0, min(1.0, predRaw))

trigLevel = 1 - compThresh
loaded = finalLoad > trigLevel
expansion = rangeNow > atrVal * expMult
expansionEdge = expansion and not expansion[1]
wasLoaded = loaded or loaded[1]

releaseUp = wasLoaded and expansionEdge and risingVoV and close > open
releaseDn = wasLoaded and expansionEdge and risingVoV and close < open

expRatio = rangeNow / max(atrVal, 0.000000001)
coilState = loaded ? (predictability > 0.5 ? 2.0 : 1.0) : 0.0
coneSize = (0.6 + finalLoad * 1.2) * markerSize

if releaseUp { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Up", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if releaseDn { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Dn", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if releaseUp { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Release Up", "coneup", "#22cc88", coneSize, 0, "separate") }
if releaseDn { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Release Dn", "conedown", "#ff4477", coneSize, 0, "separate") }
if loaded { bgcolor("#22aaff") }

plot(finalLoad, "Final Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predictability, "Predictability", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
hline(0.75, "#888888", "separate")
hline(0.5, "#444444", "separate")
plot3d(finalLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "surface", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictability, "Predictability 3D", "ribbon", "#b48cff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(coilState, "Coil State 3D", "bars3d", "#ffd43b", "separate", 2)

k = input(7, "K Neighbors", 1, 15, 1)
featWin = input(20, "Feature Window", 5, 60, 1)
marginThresh = input(0.42, "Margin Threshold", 0.1, 0.9, 0.01)
disagThresh = input(0.35, "Disagreement Threshold", 0.05, 0.9, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

// ─── Model calculations: raw OHLCV features only ───
tiny = 0.000000001
prevCloseRef = close[1]
retRaw = (close - prevCloseRef) / (prevCloseRef + tiny)
rngRaw = (high - low) / (close + tiny)
bodyRaw = (close - open) / (high - low + tiny)

absRet = abs(retRaw)
absRng = abs(rngRaw)
absBody = abs(bodyRaw)

maxRet = highest(absRet, featWin) + tiny
maxRng = highest(absRng, featWin) + tiny
maxBody = highest(absBody, featWin) + tiny

f1 = retRaw / maxRet
f2 = rngRaw / maxRng
f3 = bodyRaw / maxBody

// ─── Persistent feature + close history ───
varip f1Hist = array(0)
varip f2Hist = array(0)
varip f3Hist = array(0)
varip closeHist = array(0)

array.push(f1Hist, f1)
array.push(f2Hist, f2)
array.push(f3Hist, f3)
array.push(closeHist, close)

// ─── KNN vote over last featWin bars ───
var upVotes = 0.0
var downVotes = 0.0
var margin = 0.0
var disag = 0.5
var mean20 = 0.0
var spreadN = 0.0

numBars = array.size(closeHist)

if numBars > featWin + 1 {
    bestDist = array()
    bestTarg = array()
    nbDist = array()
    ii = 0
    while ii < k {
        array.push(bestDist, 999999.0)
        array.push(bestTarg, 0)
        array.push(nbDist, 0.0)
        ii := ii + 1
    }

    cur1 = f1Hist[numBars - 1]
    cur2 = f2Hist[numBars - 1]
    cur3 = f3Hist[numBars - 1]

    sStart = numBars - 1 - featWin
    sum20 = 0.0
    jj = sStart
    while jj < numBars - 1 {
        e1 = cur1 - f1Hist[jj]
        e2 = cur2 - f2Hist[jj]
        e3 = cur3 - f3Hist[jj]
        dd = sqrt(e1 * e1 + e2 * e2 + e3 * e3)
        sum20 := sum20 + dd

        nxt = closeHist[jj + 1]
        lbl = 0
        if nxt > closeHist[jj] {
            lbl := 1
        } else {
            lbl := 0 - 1
        }

        insIdx = 0 - 1
        mm = 0
        while mm < k {
            if dd < bestDist[mm] {
                insIdx := mm
                mm := k
            }
            mm := mm + 1
        }
        if insIdx >= 0 {
            mm = k - 1
            while mm > insIdx {
                array.set(bestDist, mm, bestDist[mm - 1])
                array.set(bestTarg, mm, bestTarg[mm - 1])
                mm := mm - 1
            }
            array.set(bestDist, insIdx, dd)
            array.set(bestTarg, insIdx, lbl)
        }
        jj := jj + 1
    }
    mean20 := sum20 / featWin

    upC = 0.0
    dnC = 0.0
    mm = 0
    while mm < k {
        if bestDist[mm] < 999998.0 {
            array.set(nbDist, mm, bestDist[mm])
            if bestTarg[mm] == 1 {
                upC := upC + 1
            } else {
                dnC := dnC + 1
            }
        }
        mm := mm + 1
    }
    upVotes := upC
    downVotes := dnC

    mgn = (upC - dnC) / k
    margin := mgn

    meanN = 0.0
    mm = 0
    while mm < k {
        meanN := meanN + nbDist[mm]
        mm := mm + 1
    }
    meanN := meanN / k
    varN = 0.0
    mm = 0
    while mm < k {
        dev = nbDist[mm] - meanN
        varN := varN + dev * dev
        mm := mm + 1
    }
    varN := varN / k
    stdN = sqrt(varN)
    spreadN := stdN
    dSpread = stdN / (mean20 + tiny)
    disag := dSpread * (1.0 - abs(mgn))
}

// ─── Signal conditions: both channels must agree ───
contested = abs(margin) < 0.20 or disag >= 0.60
buyCond = margin > marginThresh and disag < disagThresh and contested == false
sellCond = margin < (0 - marginThresh) and disag < disagThresh and contested == false

var coolBuy = -100.0
var coolSell = -100.0
buySig = buyCond and bar_index - coolBuy > 5
sellSig = sellCond and bar_index - coolSell > 5
if buySig {
    coolBuy := bar_index
}
if sellSig {
    coolSell := bar_index
}

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

// ─── 2D rendering: two independently readable channels ───
plot(margin, "Vote Margin", "#22cc88", 2, "separate")
plot(disag, "Disagreement", "#ffd43b", 2, "separate")
plot(spreadN, "Spread Twin", "rgba(255,212,59,0.5)", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
hline(marginThresh, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(0 - marginThresh, "#ff4477", "separate")
hline(disagThresh, "#ffd43b", "separate")

// ─── 3D form: crisp = tall narrow opaque pillar, contested = short wide flat slab ───
// Height / direction = Channel A margin as columns; footprint = Channel B disagreement cloud.
plot3d(margin, "Margin Pillars", "bars3d", "#22cc88", "separate")
plot3d(disag, "Disagreement Cloud", "scatter", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length", 5, 100, 1)
confBars = input(2, "Confirmation Bars", 1, 5, 1)
stopTicks = input(15, "Stop Distance Ticks", 1, 100, 1)
minDisp = input(0.1, "Min Structure Displacement %", 0.05, 2.0, 0.05)
tickSize = input(0.25, "Min Tick Size", 0.01, 5.0, 0.01)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
priorBullExt = htfHigh[1]
priorBearExt = htfLow[1]
safeBullExt = priorBullExt + 0.000000001
safeBearExt = priorBearExt + 0.000000001
bullNow = htfClose > priorBullExt
bearNow = htfClose < priorBearExt
bullHold2 = bullNow and bullNow[1]
bullHold3 = bullHold2 and bullNow[2]
bullHold4 = bullHold3 and bullNow[3]
bullHold5 = bullHold4 and bullNow[4]
bearHold2 = bearNow and bearNow[1]
bearHold3 = bearHold2 and bearNow[2]
bearHold4 = bearHold3 and bearNow[3]
bearHold5 = bearHold4 and bearNow[4]
bullConfBase = confBars == 1 ? bullNow : confBars == 2 ? bullHold2 : confBars == 3 ? bullHold3 : confBars == 4 ? bullHold4 : bullHold5
bearConfBase = confBars == 1 ? bearNow : confBars == 2 ? bearHold2 : confBars == 3 ? bearHold3 : confBars == 4 ? bearHold4 : bearHold5
bullConf = bullConfBase and htfClose == htfClose
bearConf = bearConfBase and htfClose == htfClose
dispBull = abs(htfClose - priorBullExt) / safeBullExt * 100
dispBear = abs(htfClose - priorBearExt) / safeBearExt * 100
qualityBull = min(dispBull / minDisp, 1.0)
qualityBear = min(dispBear / minDisp, 1.0)
confBull = 0.5 + 0.5 * qualityBull
confBear = 0.5 + 0.5 * qualityBear
stopDist = stopTicks * tickSize

var longEntryPx = 0.0
var shortEntryPx = 0.0
var longStopPx = 0.0
var shortStopPx = 0.0
var posLong = 0.0
var posShort = 0.0

breakHigh = crossover(close, sessHigh[1])
breakLow = crossunder(close, sessLow[1])
buySig = breakHigh and bullConf and posLong == 0.0
sellSig = breakLow and bearConf and posShort == 0.0
exitLongSig = posLong == 1.0 and (bearConf or low <= longStopPx)
exitShortSig = posShort == 1.0 and (bullConf or high >= shortStopPx)

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confBull)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    longEntryPx := close
    longStopPx := close - stopDist
    posLong := 1.0
    posShort := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confBear)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    shortEntryPx := close
    shortStopPx := close + stopDist
    posShort := 1.0
    posLong := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLongSig {
    model.longExit("siege-long")
    posLong := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "ExitL", "triangledown", "#ffcc00")
}
if exitShortSig {
    model.shortExit("siege-short")
    posShort := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "ExitS", "triangleup", "#ffcc00")
}

stopLine = posLong == 1.0 ? longStopPx : posShort == 1.0 ? shortStopPx : close
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(stopLine, "Hard Stop", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")

volLen = input(20, "Volatility Length", 5, 50, 1)
momLen = input(12, "Momentum Length", 2, 30, 1)
brkLen = input(20, "Breakout Length", 5, 50, 1)
volMult = input(1.0, "Volatility Multiplier", 0.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

priceChange = close - close[1]

mom = close - close[momLen]
resHist = highest(high, brkLen)
res = resHist[1]
supHist = lowest(low, brkLen)
sup = supHist[1]
upper = res + volMult * vol
lower = sup - volMult * vol

buySig = crossover(close, upper) and mom > 0
sellSig = crossunder(close, lower) and mom < 0

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "3d")
}

plot(upper, "Upper Trigger", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(lower, "Lower Trigger", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(mom, "Momentum", "#33aaff", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(upper, "Upper 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(lower, "Lower 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 1)

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
f236 = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6%", 0.0, 1.0, 0.001)
f382 = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2%", 0.0, 1.0, 0.001)
f50 = input(0.5, "Fib 50%", 0.0, 1.0, 0.001)
f618 = input(0.618, "Fib 61.8%", 0.0, 1.0, 0.001)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

hh = highest(high, lookback)
ll = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = hh - ll
L236 = ll + rng * f236
L382 = ll + rng * f382
L50 = ll + rng * f50
L618 = ll + rng * f618

var lastDir = 0

buySig = close[1] <= L618[1] and close > L618
sellSig = close[1] >= L382[1] and close < L382

if barstate.isconfirmed and buySig {
    lastDir := 1
}
if barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig {
    lastDir := -1
}

if barstate.isconfirmed and buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "fibEvent")
}
if barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Loss 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Loss 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, high, "Loss 38.2%", "#ff4477", 1, "fibEvent")
}

plot(L236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(L382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(L50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(L618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(L236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(L382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(L50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(L618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Horizon", 5, 20, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Horizon", 15, 50, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Horizon", 30, 100, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Range Length", 20, 120, 1)
compLook = input(60, "Compression Lookback", 20, 120, 1)
expMult = input(1.15, "Expansion Mult", 1.02, 2.0, 0.01)
bullThr = input(0.6, "Skew Bull Threshold", 0.51, 0.9, 0.01)
bearThr = input(0.4, "Skew Bear Threshold", 0.1, 0.49, 0.01)
smoothLen = input(3, "Spread Smoothing Length", 2, 10, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = log(close / close[1])
rvFast = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt(fastLen)
rvMed = stdev(r, medLen) * sqrt(medLen)
rvSlow = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt(slowLen)

rollLow = lowest(low, skewLen)
rollHigh = highest(high, skewLen)
rollRange = rollHigh - rollLow + 0.000000001
skew = (close - rollLow) / rollRange

spreadFM = rvFast - rvMed
spreadMS = rvMed - rvSlow
spreadFS = rvFast - rvSlow
spreadFS_s = (spreadFS + spreadFS[1] + spreadFS[2]) / 3

comp = lowest(rvFast, compLook)
compressed = rvFast <= comp * 1.05
expanded = rvFast > rvFast[1] * expMult and rvFast > comp * expMult and rvFast > rvMed

bullFlip = skew > bullThr and skew[1] <= bullThr
bearFlip = skew < bearThr and skew[1] >= bearThr

var lastSig = 0

buyRaw = expanded and bullFlip
sellRaw = expanded and bearFlip
buySig = buyRaw and lastSig != 1
sellSig = sellRaw and lastSig != -1

if buySig {
    lastSig := 1
}
if sellSig {
    lastSig := -1
}

expSpike = expanded ? rvFast : 0.0

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

plot3d(rvSlow, "Term Structure", "manifold", "#8a5cf6", "separate", 0)
plot3d(rvFast, "Fast Spine", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate", 1)
plot3d(expSpike, "Expansion Impulse", "bars3d", "#ffaa00", "separate", 2)

plot(spreadFS_s, "Spread F-S", "#ffaa00", 2, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#33ccff", 1, "separate")
hline(0.6, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(0.4, "#ff4477", "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")

ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(100, "Ch5 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
maxDbm = input(100, "Max dBm", 50, 150, 1)
scaleFactor = input(1.0, "Scale Factor", 0.1, 3.0, 0.1)
baseThickness = input(1, "Base Thickness", 1, 5, 1)
thicknessFactor = input(0.05, "Thickness Factor", 0.01, 0.2, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

micro1 = close - open
micro2 = high - low
micro3 = close - close[1]
micro5 = (close - open) * 0.5 + (high - low) * 0.2

c1raw = ch1 + micro1
c2raw = ch2 + micro1 * 0.5
c3raw = ch3 + micro2 * 0.2
c4raw = ch4 + micro3
c5raw = ch5 + micro5

c1t = max(c1raw, 0)
c1 = min(c1t, 100)
c2t = max(c2raw, 0)
c2 = min(c2t, 100)
c3t = max(c3raw, 0)
c3 = min(c3t, 100)
c4t = max(c4raw, 0)
c4 = min(c4t, 100)
c5t = max(c5raw, 0)
c5 = min(c5t, 100)

avg = (c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 + c5) / 5

H3 = c3 * scaleFactor
H4 = c4 * scaleFactor
H5 = c5 * scaleFactor

thick = baseThickness + avg * thicknessFactor
thickW = min(max(thick, 1), 5)

h4Highest = H4 > H1 and H4 > H2 and H4 > H3 and H4 > H5
h2Highest = H2 > H1 and H2 > H3 and H2 > H4 and H2 > H5

buySig = avg > 60 and avg[1] <= 60 and H5 > H1 and h4Highest
sellSig = avg < 40 and avg[1] >= 40 and H1 > H5 and h2Highest

up90 = (c1 > 90 and c1[1] <= 90) or (c2 > 90 and c2[1] <= 90) or (c3 > 90 and c3[1] <= 90) or (c4 > 90 and c4[1] <= 90) or (c5 > 90 and c5[1] <= 90)
dn10 = (c1 < 10 and c1[1] >= 10) or (c2 < 10 and c2[1] >= 10) or (c3 < 10 and c3[1] >= 10) or (c4 < 10 and c4[1] >= 10) or (c5 < 10 and c5[1] >= 10)
alertSig = up90 or dn10

var coolB = 0

coolB := coolB + 1
coolS := coolS + 1
buyFire = buySig and coolB > 5
sellFire = sellSig and coolS > 5
if buyFire {

if sellFire {

plot(H5, "H5 Ch5 high", "#22ff88", 1, "separate")
plot(avg, "AVG Spline", "#33ddff", 2, "separate")

plot3d(avg, "Spline Tops", "ribbon", "#33ddff", "separate")
plot3d(H4, "Cylinders", "bars3d", "#ffcc00", "separate", 1)

if buyFire {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, H4, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellFire {

}

wx0 = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wy0 = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wz0 = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
windSpeedIn = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
minSpeed = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 50.0, 1.0)
maxSpeed = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
baseTail = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
lenPerKnot = input(0.1, "Length Per Knot", 0.0, 1.0, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = (close - open) * 0.2
chop = (high - low) * 0.3
wx = wx0 + drift * 0.1
wy = wy0 + chop * 0.05
wz = wz0 + drift * 0.05
wspd = windSpeedIn + chop + abs(drift) * 0.5

mag = sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz)
nx = mag == 0 ? 1.0 : wx / (mag + 0.000000001)
ny = mag == 0 ? 0.0 : wy / (mag + 0.000000001)
nz = mag == 0 ? 0.0 : wz / (mag + 0.000000001)

horiz = sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy)
yawRad = atan2(wy, wx)
pitchRad = atan2(wz, horiz + 0.000000001)
rollDeg = 0.0
yawDeg = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.29578

tailLen = baseTail + lenPerKnot * wspd

span = maxSpeed - minSpeed + 0.000000001
tRaw = (wspd - minSpeed) / span
tClamped = max(0.0, min(1.0, tRaw))
gradR = tClamped
gradG = 0.65 * tClamped
gradB = 1.0 - tClamped
gradMag = sqrt(gradR * gradR + gradG * gradG + gradB * gradB + 0.000000001)
arrowColor = tClamped > 0.5 ? "#ff8800" : "#2266ff"
arrowSize = markerSize * (0.6 + tailLen * 0.2)

buyLvl = maxSpeed * 0.7
sellLvl = minSpeed + (maxSpeed - minSpeed) * 0.2
buySig = crossover(wspd, buyLvl) and nz > 0
sellSig = crossunder(wspd, sellLvl)
dotPrior = nx * nx[1] + ny * ny[1] + nz * nz[1]
flipSig = dotPrior < 0
alertSig = wspd > maxSpeed or flipSig
alertEdge = alertSig and not alertSig[1]

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, wspd, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", arrowSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, wspd, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", arrowSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if alertEdge {
    label3d(bar_index, wspd, "WIND ALERT", "#ff8800", 1.0, 2, "separate")
}

plot(wspd, "Wind Speed kn", "#2266ff", 2, "separate")
plot(tailLen, "Tail Length", "#ff8800", 1, "separate")
plot3d(wspd, "Wind Speed", "ribbon", "#2266ff", "separate")
plot3d(tailLen, "Tail Length", "line3d", "#ff8800", "separate", 1)

flowBase = input(130.0, "Flow Base PSI", 50.0, 250.0, 1.0)
crit = input(150, "Critical Threshold", 50, 300, 1)
spinFactor = input(1.0, "Spin Factor", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
ringCount = input(5, "Ring Count", 1, 8, 1)
ringRate = input(1.0, "Ring Expansion Rate", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

flowPsi = flowBase + (close - open) * 4.0 + (high - low) * 2.0
spinSpeed = flowPsi * spinFactor
overState = flowPsi > crit
shockOuter = flowPsi + (high - low) * 2.0 + (close - open)

var discAngle = 0.0
var rr1 = 0.0
var rr2 = 0.0
var rr3 = 0.0
var rr4 = 0.0
var rr5 = 0.0

if overState {
  rr1 := rr1 + ringRate * 1.0
  rr2 := rr2 + ringRate * 2.0
  rr3 := rr3 + ringRate * 3.0
  rr4 := rr4 + ringRate * 4.0
  rr5 := rr5 + ringRate * 5.0
} else {
  discAngle := discAngle + spinSpeed
  rr1 := 0.0
  rr2 := 0.0
  rr3 := 0.0
  rr4 := 0.0
  rr5 := 0.0
}

overSig = overState and not overState[1]
resetSig = not overState and overState[1]

if overSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Lock", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flowPsi, "Lock", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0, 0, "separate")
  label3d(bar_index, flowPsi + 12.0, "OVERPRESSURE", "#ff4477", 2, 5, "separate")
  model.shortEntry("OverP", 1.0)
}

if resetSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reset", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flowPsi, "Reset", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0, 0, "separate")
  model.exit("OverP")
}

if overState {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flowPsi, "Ring1", "torus", "#ff8844", 0.6, 1, "separate")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flowPsi, "Ring2", "torus", "#ff6644", 1.0, 2, "separate")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flowPsi, "Ring3", "torus", "#ff4477", 1.4, 3, "separate")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flowPsi, "Ring4", "torus", "#ff3377", 1.8, 4, "separate")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flowPsi, "Ring5", "torus", "#ff2277", 2.2, 5, "separate")
}

plot(flowPsi, "Flow PSI", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(spinSpeed, "Spin Speed", "#88ddff", 1, "separate")
hline(crit, "#ff4477", "separate")
plot3d(flowPsi, "Valve Disc", "torus", "#22aaff", "separate")
plot3d(shockOuter, "Shockwaves", "vortex", "#ff4477", "separate", 1)
